_evidence: File state of the block I/O routines that run on a file their caller has just opened: the save-file pair 0x538162 (read) / 0x5381e6 (write), callers 0x537fb6/0x538019 and 0x537f33/0x538019, mode byte [0x829ba3], and the temp-file pair 0x5386a5 (read) / 0x538635 (write), callers 0x53855e / 0x53859e, mode byte [0x829c68]. Mode 2 = file: the callers first run 0x538112 / 0x5385df, which CreateFileA the file (0x8297a0, OPEN_EXISTING) and store the handle in [0x81ea28] (open flag [0x81ea2c] = 0xff) or return CF=1 on failure, and close it afterwards (0x538264 / 0x53862f -> 0x53646a CloseHandle); the routines then call SetFilePointer(handle, offset, NULL, FILE_BEGIN) and ReadFile/WriteFile on [0x81ea28]. So the handle is a file opened before the call: drawn from the pre-opened fake files 0x3000/0x3004 (gp4re/stubs.py 'File handles', seeded contents; offsets beyond their size give short or empty reads, both valid) and, for the SetFilePointer failure arm ('cmp eax,-1; je'), 0xffffffff (an invalid handle: SetFilePointer returns -1). Mode bytes: [0x829ba3] is written only with 1 (0x537eb1, memory logging), 2 (0x537edb, disk) and 0 (0x53827a); the callers return at once for 0 ('cmp byte [0x829ba3],0; je'), so 0x538162/0x5381e6 see 1 (the 'rep movsb' copy, live) or 2; 0 is kept as a harmless extra input (it takes the same copy arm). [0x829c68] is written only with 2 (0x538309) and 0 (0x538717), and the callers 0x53855e/0x53859e return at once for 0 ('cmp byte [0x829c68],0; je 0x53859d/0x5385de', nothing in between writes it), so 0x538635/0x5386a5 only ever run with mode 2 in the game: their copy arm (mode != 2, 0x53869d/0x53870d) is dead. It is still drawn here (mode 0) so the reconstruction's copy arm is compared too; the copy runs between the spec's own buffers. Values are synthetic.
